independent_findings.phase1_thumb_risk: Small dark notch and brown hook on glove right edge; closed glove silhouette is clear, exact cylindrical grip/short thumb wrap is not established.
independent_findings.phase3_4_thumb_risk: Top brown folds and dark gaps are ambiguous glove details; no clear foreign handle, but no accepted real thumb contour or grip channel.
independent_findings.motion_direction: Belly-height phase2 to chest/helmet-under phase3 gives a rising static sequence with compact sleeve; only future actual blade fit / native paired inputs can judge the strike.
independent_findings.helmet_identity: Bell silhouette, top bolt and two amber eyes remain visible throughout; source tilt/shading changes, no exact-pixel identity or continuous head stability claim.
independent_findings.changes_not_pixel_locked: 171 is not a patch preserving all five unrequested phases pixel-exact; every source SHA differs. Similar appearance is not pixel identity.
